question: Sunlight is the main source of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin D**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vitamin:

 
 
• Vitamins are one of the essential micronutrients needed in small quantities for the proper functioning of its metabolism.
 
• Based on their solubility, it is classified into 4 groups: Water and fat-soluble vitamins.
 
• Fat-soluble vitamins are vitamins A, D, E, and K.
 
• Water-soluble vitamins are Vitamins B and C.
 
• Vitamin D is known as ‘Sunshine Vitamin’. Because our body produces vitamin D naturally when it's directly exposed to sunlight.
 
• Vitamin D protects the teeth and bones and defends against disease s. 
 
 

**Thus, Sunlight is the source of Vitamin D.**__
